convention: Stable append-only IDs EVD-<DOMAIN>-<SHORT>-<n>. review_status seed->verified->change-proposed->approved->superseded. Values never auto-change (D20); crawler maintains url/doi/last_verified only. All entries illustrative pending clinical sign-off + validation (Doc 13).

evidence.claim: ApoB is a primary atherogenic target; lower is better, treat-to-target in high risk (~<80 mg/dL primary prevention)
evidence.title: 2018 ACC/AHA Cholesterol Guideline; 2019 ESC/EAS Dyslipidaemias

evidence.claim: Optimal SBP <120 mmHg; hypertension thresholds and treatment targets
evidence.title: 2017 ACC/AHA Hypertension Guideline; 2023 ESH Guidelines

evidence.claim: Lp(a) is an independent, largely genetic CV risk factor; measure once; high regional relevance with consanguinity
evidence.title: 2022 EAS Lp(a) Consensus

evidence.claim: HbA1c diagnostic thresholds (>=5.7% prediabetes, >=6.5% diabetes); glycemic targets
evidence.title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes

evidence.claim: SGLT2 inhibitors for T2D with CV/renal benefit; GLP-1 RA for weight/CV benefit
evidence.title: ADA 2024 Pharmacologic Approaches; KDIGO 2022/2024 Diabetes-in-CKD

evidence.claim: eGFR/UACR staging of CKD (KDIGO heat-map); progression and referral thresholds
evidence.title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of CKD

evidence.claim: Use the 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation WITHOUT a race coefficient (race-free)
evidence.title: Inker et al., New Creatinine- and Cystatin C-Based Equations without Race, NEJM

evidence.claim: Hyperkalemia thresholds and emergency management; ACE-i/ARB/SGLT2i expected K+ shifts
evidence.title: Clinical hyperkalemia management; RAASi monitoring

evidence.claim: FIB-4 for fibrosis risk stratification in MASLD/NAFLD; referral pathway
evidence.title: AASLD 2023 MASLD Practice Guidance; EASL

evidence.claim: hsCRP cardiovascular risk stratification cutpoints (<1 / 1-3 / >3 mg/L)
evidence.title: AHA/CDC Markers of Inflammation in Cardiovascular Disease

evidence.claim: Sex-specific haemoglobin/anaemia thresholds; pregnancy trimester floors
evidence.title: WHO Haemoglobin concentrations for the diagnosis of anaemia

evidence.claim: TSH reference range; preconception (0.5-2.5) and trimester-specific pregnancy targets
evidence.title: ATA Guidelines for Thyroid Disease in Pregnancy 2017; thyroid reference ranges

evidence.claim: Male testosterone reference; diagnose hypogonadism on two morning low draws + symptoms; age decline normal
evidence.title: Testosterone Therapy in Men with Hypogonadism

evidence.claim: Vitamin D sufficiency/repletion; deficiency near-universal in the Gulf despite sun (clothing, indoor, latitude)
evidence.title: Endocrine Society Vitamin D Guideline; UAE vitamin D deficiency prevalence studies

evidence.claim: Omega-3 index target >=8%; cardiovascular and inflammatory relevance
evidence.title: AHA Science Advisory on Omega-3

evidence.claim: Cardiorespiratory fitness (VO2max) age-/sex-normed percentiles; strong mortality predictor
evidence.title: ACSM Guidelines for Exercise Testing and Prescription; FRIEND registry norms

evidence.claim: Ethnic-specific BMI/waist cutoffs: WHO Asian BMI >=23 overweight / >=27.5 obese; IDF lower waist thresholds for South Asians
evidence.title: WHO Expert Consultation Asian BMI (Lancet 2004); IDF ethnic-specific waist

evidence.claim: BMD T-score osteoporosis definition; FRAX risk; postmenopausal acceleration
evidence.title: WHO osteoporosis T-score criteria; FRAX

evidence.claim: PHQ-9 / GAD-7 validated screening; item-9 self-harm forces crisis escalation
evidence.title: PHQ-9 (Kroenke 2001); GAD-7 (Spitzer 2006)

evidence.claim: SpO2 <92% (no chronic lung disease) is an acute hypoxemia danger threshold; device-quality caveats
evidence.title: WHO pulse oximetry / hypoxaemia thresholds

evidence.claim: Pre-eclampsia diagnosis (BP>=140/90 + proteinuria/organ; severe>=160/110) -> emergency; GDM via OGTT
evidence.title: ACOG Gestational Hypertension/Pre-eclampsia; IADPSG/ADA GDM criteria

evidence.claim: STRAW+10 reproductive-aging staging for peri/postmenopause
evidence.title: Harlow et al., Executive summary of the STRAW+10 staging system

evidence.claim: Gender-affirming hormone therapy targets; interpret hormone-sensitive labs against affirmed milieu
evidence.title: Endocrine Society GAHT Guideline 2017; WPATH SOC-8 2022

evidence.claim: Pooled-cohort/ASCVD equations under-predict risk in South Asians; use ethnicity-aware equations (QRISK3) and screen earlier
evidence.title: QRISK3 (Hippisley-Cox 2017); ACC/AHA risk-enhancer note for South Asian ancestry

evidence.claim: G6PD deficiency is prevalent regionally; screen before oxidant drugs (e.g. rasburicase, dapsone, primaquine, some sulfonamides); avoid triggers
evidence.title: WHO G6PD deficiency classification; oxidant-drug avoidance

evidence.claim: Thalassemia/hemoglobinopathy high carrier rates in the region; mandatory premarital screening; interpret Hgb/MCV with carrier status
evidence.title: UAE Premarital Screening & Genetic Counselling Program; WHO haemoglobinopathies

evidence.claim: Familial hypercholesterolemia under-diagnosed; cascade screening; high regional relevance with consanguinity (incl. homozygous FH)
evidence.title: EAS FH Consensus; cascade-screening recommendations

evidence.claim: UAE has among the world's highest age-adjusted diabetes/obesity prevalence; aggressive metabolic screening warranted
evidence.title: IDF Diabetes Atlas (UAE); MoHAP/Emirates Diabetes Society NCD strategy

evidence.claim: Ramadan fasting risk stratification for diabetes; med-timing changes; when fasting is medically inadvisable; hydration/hypoglycemia safety
evidence.title: IDF-DAR Practical Guidelines (Diabetes and Ramadan)

evidence.claim: Vitamin D deficiency is highly prevalent in the UAE across ages/sexes; routine repletion consideration
evidence.title: UAE/Gulf vitamin D deficiency epidemiology; local repletion protocols

evidence.claim: RAAS inhibitors (ACE-i/ARB) cause expected small eGFR dip and K+ rise; not auto-critical; monitor
evidence.title: RAASi initiation/monitoring guidance

evidence.claim: Beta-blockers blunt resting HR / HRV / VO2max / HR-recovery; these become confounded fitness signals
evidence.title: Beta-blocker chronotropic effects (pharmacology consensus)

evidence.claim: Statin-controlled ApoB/LDL is MANAGED not resolved; underlying atherogenic risk persists
evidence.title: Lipid-lowering therapy monitoring; residual risk

evidence.claim: 150-300 min/wk moderate aerobic + 2x/wk resistance physical-activity targets
evidence.title: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour

evidence.claim: 7-9 h sleep for adults; regularity and efficiency targets; CVD/metabolic/mood links
evidence.title: AASM/Sleep Research Society adult sleep-duration consensus

evidence.claim: Complete blood count reference ranges (WBC, platelets, hematocrit); leukocytosis/cytopenia thresholds
evidence.title: Standard CBC reference intervals (laboratory/haematology consensus)

evidence.claim: Liver function test reference ranges incl. bilirubin; hyperbilirubinemia thresholds
evidence.title: Standard LFT reference intervals; evaluation of abnormal liver chemistries

evidence.claim: Serum albumin as nutrition/inflammation/synthetic-function marker; hypoalbuminemia significance
evidence.title: ESPEN guidance on nutritional biomarkers; albumin interpretation

evidence.claim: Morning cortisol reference; adrenal insufficiency/excess evaluation
evidence.title: Endocrine Society guidance on adrenal function testing

evidence.claim: Grip strength sex-specific cut-points for probable sarcopenia (EWGSOP2)
evidence.title: Cruz-Jentoft et al., Sarcopenia: revised European consensus (EWGSOP2)

evidence.claim: Vitamin B12 reference and deficiency thresholds; high relevance with metformin and vegetarian diets (prevalent regionally)
evidence.title: British Society for Haematology B12/folate guideline

evidence.claim: Loneliness/social isolation is an independent health risk; UCLA-3 screening
evidence.title: US Surgeon General Advisory on Social Connection 2023; UCLA-3 loneliness scale
